title: Update: Black and White inspired voxel god game
author: CapitanUncino19
selftext:
A little while ago I [posted](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1x3vbt3/im_making_a_black_whitestyle_voxel_god_game_with/) about the voxel god game I'm making. Thanks for all the encouragement! It now has a name, Handvoll, and a free demo you can play in the browser, on desktop or phone:



[https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll](https://capitanuncino.itch.io/handvoll)



You're a newborn god that lends a helping hand. Grab the hounds hunting a gatherer and throw them into the sea, rip up trees for your people's shrine, win over the next village with gifts or with fear, then defend your shrine when raiders land. A run takes a few minutes, and every island is generated fresh.



Everything is one HTML file. The island, the people and animals, the sound and the music are all generated in code with Three.js, and the code itself was written with AI (Opus 5.5).



I'd love to hear your thoughts on the basic gameplay mechanics etc.
